AcceptancePolicy.description: What happens to a value an enricher proposes for a property.
AcceptancePolicy.title: AcceptancePolicy

AcceptanceState.description: Where a proposed enrichment value is.
AcceptanceState.title: AcceptanceState

AccessLevel.description: Who may run a command or invoke an action (ADR-0011, ADR-0013).
AccessLevel.title: AccessLevel

Account.description: One account in its current state. A projection of the `Account.*` events.

account_id.description: Immutable id; the ledger stream is `account:<account_id>`.

is_admin.description: 1 when `roles` holds `admin`. Lets the last-admin check count in plain SQL.

roles.description: JSON list of roles from `admin`, `user` and `document_controller`, for example `["user", "document_controller"]`.

version.description: Version of the account stream after the last event.

Account.title: Account

AccountCreatedPayload.description: An account was created. A password, if any, is held outside the ledger. Internal: never delivered to webhooks.
AccountCreatedPayload.title: AccountCreatedPayload

AccountDisabledPayload.description: An account was disabled: it cannot sign in and its sessions and agent tokens stop working. Internal: never delivered to webhooks.
AccountDisabledPayload.title: AccountDisabledPayload

AccountEnabledPayload.description: A disabled account was enabled again. Internal: never delivered to webhooks.
AccountEnabledPayload.title: AccountEnabledPayload

AccountEventPayload.description: Payload of an `Account.*` or `AgentToken.*` event. The stream is `account:<account_id>`; no payload holds a secret. These events are internal: the webhook dispatcher never delivers them and the events API shows them to admins only.
AccountEventPayload.title: AccountEventPayload

AccountKind.description: What kind of principal an account is.
AccountKind.title: AccountKind

AccountPasswordChangedPayload.description: The password of an account was set or changed. The event records that it happened, never the password or its hash. Internal: never delivered to webhooks.

forced.description: True for an admin reset or a bootstrap, false for the person changing their own.

AccountPasswordChangedPayload.title: AccountPasswordChangedPayload

AccountRole.description: The three roles of Phase 1 (ADR-0008 decision 3, amended by ADR-0013).
AccountRole.title: AccountRole

AccountRolesSetPayload.description: The roles of an account were replaced. Internal: never delivered to webhooks.
AccountRolesSetPayload.title: AccountRolesSetPayload

http_status.description: HTTP status of a webhook action.

ActionDefinition.description: An operation people, rules and agents may ask for (brief 18.7, 19.2). One row per definition in its current version; `ReviseAction` bumps `version`, and an invocation names the version it ran. The webhook signing secret lives in `int_secret`; `secret_id` names it.

applies_to.description: `ActionTarget` as JSON: record type globs and an optional query-language condition.

executor_config.description: `JobExecutorConfig` or `WebhookExecutorConfig` as JSON. Never holds a secret.

integration_app.description: The integration app this action belongs to, when there is one.

name.description: A slug, unique across the ledger.

retired.description: A retired definition cannot be invoked; its invocations stay readable.

scope.description: `company` actions may be invoked on any project's records; a project action only on its own.

secret_id.description: The newest signing secret of a webhook action (the value lives in `int_secret`).

version.description: Definition version (1, 2, ...). The ledger stream version is `stream_version`.

ActionDefinition.title: ActionDefinition

ActionDefinitionDefinedPayload.description: An action was defined (version 1). A webhook action's signing secret is held outside the ledger.
examples: {"access": "user", "applies_to": {"condition": null, "record_types": ["core.Record"]}, "definition_id": "01J9Z6Q4W3X2Y1V0T9S8R7Q6P2", "description": "Send an inspection request to the NDE contractor", "enabled": true, "executor": "webhook", "executor_config": {"kind": "webhook", "timeout_s": 10.0, "url": "https://nde.example.net/hooks/request"}, "integration_app": "acme-nde", "label": "Send to NDE", "name": "send_to_nde", "owner": "user:jsmith", "parameters": [{"choices": ["RT", "UT"], "kind": "string", "label": "Method", "max_length": null, "name": "method", "required": true}], "requires_approval": false, "result_handling": ["store"], "secret_id": "01J9Z6Q4W3X2Y1V0T9S8R7Q6P3", "side_effect_class": "external", "version": 1}

applies_to.description: ActionTarget object: record type globs and an optional condition.

requires_approval.description: Whether an invocation waits for a second person.

secret_id.description: Id of the first signing secret of a webhook action (not the secret).

version.description: Definition version.

ActionDefinitionDefinedPayload.title: ActionDefinitionDefinedPayload

ActionDefinitionEventPayload.description: Payload of an `ActionDefinition.*` event. The stream is the definition (`core.ActionDefinition`); a secret is held outside the ledger.
ActionDefinitionEventPayload.title: ActionDefinitionEventPayload

ActionDefinitionRetiredPayload.description: An action was retired: it can no longer be invoked; its invocations stay readable.
ActionDefinitionRetiredPayload.title: ActionDefinitionRetiredPayload

ActionDefinitionRevisedPayload.description: An action was revised; the event carries the whole new definition and the row is replaced.

version.description: The new definition version.

ActionDefinitionRevisedPayload.title: ActionDefinitionRevisedPayload

ActionDefinitionSecretRotatedPayload.description: A new signing secret was issued for a webhook action; the previous one keeps verifying until the overlap ends.

previous_expires_at.description: ISO-8601 time when the previous secret stops.

previous_secret_id.description: Id of the secret being replaced.

secret_id.description: Id of the new secret (not the secret).

ActionDefinitionSecretRotatedPayload.title: ActionDefinitionSecretRotatedPayload

ActionFailedPayload.description: The action failed for good (not retried any more).

http_status.description: HTTP status of a webhook action.

problems.description: List of Problem objects (code and message).

ActionFailedPayload.title: ActionFailedPayload

ActionInvocation.description: One request to run an action (brief 18.7): Requested, then Running, then Completed or Failed. The targets are `RecordRef`s. `result` is bounded JSON; a larger one fails the invocation, it is never cut.

problems.description: A JSON list of `Problem` of a failed invocation.

proposal_id.description: Set when the action requires approval and this invocation came from an accepted proposal.

result.description: The executor's bounded JSON result of a completed invocation.

ActionInvocation.title: ActionInvocation

ActionInvocationEventPayload.description: Payload of an `Action.*` event. The stream is the invocation (`core.ActionInvocation`).
ActionInvocationEventPayload.title: ActionInvocationEventPayload

ActionInvocationTarget.description: One record an invocation acts on, for "what was run on this record" (the record page).
ActionInvocationTarget.title: ActionInvocationTarget

ActionRequestedPayload.description: An action was requested on records. The execution is queued as a job.

parameters.description: Parameters as validated against the definition.

proposal_id.description: The accepted proposal this came from, when the action requires approval.

ActionRequestedPayload.title: ActionRequestedPayload

ActivityPost.description: A broadcast post (brief 19.2, 21.1). Authored by a person, an agent or an external party; an agent's posts are labelled by its `agent:<id>` actor. A post has no replies.

body.description: Text of the post, with its `#tags` and `@mentions`.

importance.description: Importance the author gave; a signal tag raises the effective level to high.

post_id.description: Immutable post identifier; equals the ledger `stream_id`.

record_ids.description: Records the post references (the resolved record tags), without repeats.

scope.description: The project the post was made in. A post is visible wherever its project is.

ActivityPost.title: ActivityPost

AgentToken.description: The metadata of one agent token. The token itself is only in `auth_token_secret`, as a hash.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC; null for a token that does not expire.

label.description: What the token is for; shown in lists.

AgentToken.title: AgentToken

AgentTokenIssuedPayload.description: An agent token was issued. The event holds its metadata; the token is shown once and stored only as a hash. Internal: never delivered to webhooks.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 time after which the token stops working; null for none.

AgentTokenIssuedPayload.title: AgentTokenIssuedPayload

AgentTokenRevokedPayload.description: An agent token was revoked and no longer authenticates. Internal: never delivered to webhooks.
AgentTokenRevokedPayload.title: AgentTokenRevokedPayload

Any.description: Any JSON value. Used with `tl:json` for slots stored as JSON columns.
Any.title: Any

AuthAttempt.description: Failed-sign-in counters, keyed by normalised username whether or not an account exists. A lock lasts 15 minutes, for every name (a longer lock for some names would tell which exist).

username_key.description: The normalised username, cut to 64 characters.

window_started_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC of the first failure in the current window.

AuthAttempt.title: AuthAttempt

AuthAudit.description: The operational audit of authentication: sign-in success and failure, locks, unlocks, sign-out, agent token issue and revoke, password resets. It holds no secret (never a password, hash or token) and is kept 90 days. It is not a projection and not in the ledger, the archive or the lake; `tl admin audit` lists it.

actor.description: The actor that did it, when there is one.

count.description: How many times this happened in a row; repeated failures of one name in a lock window share one row, and `at` is the last of them.

detail.description: A short reason code or id (`bad_credentials`, `disabled`, a token id, the end of a lock). Never a secret.

username_key.description: The normalised username the attempt named, whether or not an account exists, or `<invalid>` when what was typed cannot be a username (it may have been a password, so it is never kept).

AuthAudit.title: AuthAudit

AuthCredential.description: A password hash. Operational; never in the ledger, the archive, the lake or webhooks.
AuthCredential.title: AuthCredential

AuthSession.description: A signed-in session. Only the SHA-256 of the token is stored; ending a session deletes the row.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC. Sign-out, disable and a password change delete the row.

AuthSession.title: AuthSession

AuthTokenSecret.description: The hash of one agent token. Only a `token_id` links it to the ledger metadata.
AuthTokenSecret.title: AuthTokenSecret

AutomationAccess.description: What a service actor (rule, inbound endpoint, enricher) may be declared to hold. Automation never runs an `admin` command in Phase 1.
AutomationAccess.title: AutomationAccess

BodyQuarantine.description: Operational state, not a projection: a record whose stored body failed verification on read (brief 31.4). Reads of the record's body are refused until the body is stored again or `tl types quarantine recheck` verifies it. A rebuild of projections never clears it.

actual_hash.description: Hash of the bytes found; null when the object is missing.

expected_hash.description: The hash the ledger recorded for the body.

BodyQuarantine.title: BodyQuarantine

CaptureHint.description: How a client should capture a file for a slot (brief 20.1).
CaptureHint.title: CaptureHint

CloudEvent.description: The CloudEvents 1.0 envelope (brief 18.3) used for webhooks, streams, the events API and exports. Extension attributes are lower-case as CloudEvents requires: `tlseq`, `tlstreamversion`, `tlcorrelationid`, `tlactor`.

dataschema.description: URI of the catalog schema of this event type.

id.description: The ledger event id. Receivers dedupe on it.

source.description: URI of the company and project the event came from.

subject.description: `urn:tl:<ulid>` of the subject record, the ordering key.

time.description: When the ledger committed the event (UTC).

CloudEvent.title: CloudEvent

CloudEventData.description: The `data` member of a webhook CloudEvent.

changes.description: Delta and full modes. Object of field path to `[old, new]`; `old` is null when the event does not carry it.

detail.description: Delta and full modes. The ledger event payload, described per event type in the catalog.

links.description: Delta and full modes. Immediate links.

record.description: Full mode only. The record projection as of delivery preparation, with its `version`.

CloudEventData.title: CloudEventData

ConformanceStatus.description: Result of evaluating a record against its effective schema (brief 6.3).
ConformanceStatus.title: ConformanceStatus

DeliveryStatus.description: Where one webhook delivery is in its life.
DeliveryStatus.title: DeliveryStatus

Enricher.description: The registration of an enricher plugin (brief 18.9): which events it follows (`when`), which properties of its own `enrich.<name>` pset layer it fills and the acceptance policy of each, and the service actor and access it runs as. `code_version` is the plugin's own version. Phase 1 enrichers are deterministic (`model_ref` is null; ADR-0008 decision 8).

enabled_from_seq.description: The `seq` of the event that last switched it on. A worker that is behind does not apply it to events from before that moment.

name.description: One path segment of the `enrich.` layer; unique across the ledger.

properties.description: A JSON list of `{name, kind, policy, threshold}`: the properties of the layer and their acceptance policy.

version.description: Registration version (1, 2, ...). The ledger stream version is `stream_version`.

Enricher.title: Enricher

EnricherEventPayload.description: Payload of an `Enricher.*` event. The stream is the enricher (`core.Enricher`).
EnricherEventPayload.title: EnricherEventPayload

EnricherRegisteredPayload.description: An enricher was registered. It starts disabled.

name.description: Enricher name; one path segment of the enrich. layer.

version.description: Registration version.

EnricherRegisteredPayload.title: EnricherRegisteredPayload

EnricherRevisedPayload.description: An enricher's registration changed; the event carries the whole new registration.

version.description: The new registration version.

EnricherRevisedPayload.title: EnricherRevisedPayload

EnrichmentAcceptedPayload.description: A person (or the enricher's own auto policy) accepted a value: it is now written to the enricher's layer of the record.

by.description: The accepting person, or the enricher's service actor.

EnrichmentAcceptedPayload.title: EnrichmentAcceptedPayload

EnrichmentCursor.description: How far an enrichment dispatcher has read the ledger.
EnrichmentCursor.title: EnrichmentCursor

EnrichmentEventPayload.description: Payload of an `Enrichment.*` event. The stream is the value (`core.EnrichmentValue`).
EnrichmentEventPayload.title: EnrichmentEventPayload

EnrichmentProposedPayload.description: An enricher proposed a value for a property of its own layer of a record. A shadow value is for evaluation and admins only.

inputs.description: List of {record, file_sha256}: what the value was made from.

value.description: A scalar or a list of scalars.

EnrichmentProposedPayload.title: EnrichmentProposedPayload

EnrichmentRejectedPayload.description: A value was rejected by a person, or replaced by a newer proposal.

by.description: The person, or the enricher's service actor for a replacement.

EnrichmentRejectedPayload.title: EnrichmentRejectedPayload

EnrichmentValue.description: A value an enricher proposed for one property of one record, with provenance (brief 18.9, 19.2). Accepting it writes only the enricher's own layer `enrich.<enricher>.<property>`; promoting it to an authoritative field is a person's own `SetPsetValues`. A `shadow` value is shown to admins and the evaluation report only.

target.description: The `RecordRef` of the record, as JSON.

value.description: A scalar or a list of scalars, as JSON.

version.description: Ledger stream version after the last event applied.

EnrichmentValue.title: EnrichmentValue

causation_id.description: Identifier of the event or command that caused this one; may be null.

correlation_id.description: Ties a command chain, import, or automated process together.

hash.description: Hash of this event chained to `prev_hash`.

payload.description: Event payload, a JSON object validated against the event type's schema.

prev_hash.description: Hash of the previous event in the same scope; null for the first.

schema_version.description: Version of the event payload schema, for upcasting.

seq.description: Global monotonic sequence; the ordering backbone.

stream_id.description: The record (aggregate) the event belongs to.

stream_type.description: Record type of the stream, for example `core.Record`.

stream_version.description: Per-stream version, used for optimistic concurrency.

EventCard.description: Feed rendering of one or more aggregated ledger events (brief 19.2, 21.1). Consecutive events with the same actor, event type and scope within a time window form one card.

card_id.description: Deterministic card id, `card:<event id of the first aggregated event>`.

event_type.description: The ledger event type every aggregated event has.

subjects.description: Records the aggregated events are about.

summary.description: Rendered one-line summary, for example `jsmith created 14 records`.

EventCard.title: EventCard

EventLinkRef.description: One immediate link of the origin record (delta mode).

id.description: `urn:tl:<ulid>` of the record at the other end.

EventLinkRef.title: EventLinkRef

EventOrigin.description: Pointer to the originating record at the version of the event (brief 18.3, `RecordRef`).

uri.description: Resolvable URI of the record at this version (`...@v7`).

version.description: Version of the record after the event.

EventOrigin.title: EventOrigin

EventPayload.description: Common parent of the event payload classes. Payloads are open: new optional fields are additive.
EventPayload.title: EventPayload

ExecutorKind.description: How an action is carried out. Phase 1 builds `job` and `webhook`; a definition naming another is refused.
ExecutorKind.title: ExecutorKind

ExtensionRecord.description: Base class of every extension record type. A package's `type.yaml` declares a class that is_a `ExtensionRecord`; its own slots are the body of an instance. A slot annotated `tl:index: true` is an index field (brief 31.4): it is copied into the pset named for the type, so the query language filters on it. The class annotation `tl:storage_mode` (`managed` or `object-backed`) says where the body lives.

conformance.description: Conformance of the current values to the effective schema.

created_at.description: Timestamp of the creating event (system time).

effective_schema_hash.description: Hash of the effective schema in force at the last write; null before Increment 2.

id.description: Immutable global identifier; equals the ledger `stream_id`.

key.description: Human-readable number, unique within a scope. Null until numbering assigns one.

last_seq.description: Ledger `seq` of the last event applied.

psets.description: Property-set values keyed by pset name, stored as a JSON object.

status.description: Workflow state; null when the record type has no workflow.

type.description: Fully qualified record type, for example `core.Record`.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last applied event (system time).

version.description: Ledger `stream_version` of the last event applied.

voided.description: Set by `Record.Voided`. Voided rows are never deleted.

ExtensionRecord.title: ExtensionRecord

FeedEditedPayload.description: A post was edited. The payload is a full replacement of the body and its tags; the earlier text stays in the ledger, so edits are visible history (brief 21.1).
FeedEditedPayload.title: FeedEditedPayload

FeedItemRow.description: One row of the feed: a post (with a tombstone once retracted) or an event card. Newest first by `occurred_at`, then `seq`. A card is extended while it is the scope's open card (`open_scope` is set); a scope has at most one open card, and it is the scope's newest card (the projector closes a card before it opens the next). This is not a unique key: a unique index on `open_scope` made every lookup and insert slower with each closed card within one transaction on Postgres, so a rebuild grew quadratically (P0-I8 D13). The newest card is found through the index on `(scope, first_seq)`.

actor.description: Author of a post, or the actor of a card's events.

base_importance.description: Importance the author gave the post (cards are low).

edit_count.description: Number of `Feed.Edited` events applied to the post.

event_count.description: 1 for a post; the number of aggregated ledger events for a card.

event_type.description: Cards only; the event type of every aggregated event.

first_seq.description: Cards only; `seq` of the first aggregated event.

first_us.description: Cards only; `recorded_at` of the first aggregated event in microseconds since the Unix epoch. An integer so the window test does not depend on how a dialect returns timestamps.

importance.description: Effective importance. High when a post has a signal tag, else `base_importance`.

item_id.description: The post id, or `card:<event id of the first aggregated event>`.

item_type.description: Whether the row is a post or an event card.

occurred_at.description: `recorded_at` of the post, or of the latest event of a card.

open_scope.description: Cards only; the scope while the card can still be extended, else null.

reactions.description: Reacting actors by reaction (a JSON object such as ack: [user:a]); empty lists are dropped.

retracted.description: True once the post was retracted. The row stays as a tombstone.

seq.description: `seq` of the posted event, or of the latest event of a card.

summary.description: Body of a post (empty once retracted) or the rendered summary of a card.

version.description: Posts only; ledger `stream_version` of the post stream after the last event applied.

FeedItemRow.title: FeedItemRow

FeedPostedPayload.description: A post was made in a project feed. It is the first event of the post stream. The projection derives the effective importance from `importance` and the tags.

importance.description: Importance the author gave. The projection derives the effective level from it and the tags.

record_ids.description: Records the post references, without repeats.

tags.description: Tags found in the body, after resolution.

FeedPostedPayload.title: FeedPostedPayload

FeedReactedPayload.description: A reaction was set or cleared on a post. The actor of the event sets (`on` true) or clears (`on` false) one acknowledgement. Reactions are limited to `ack`, `+1` and `resolved` (brief 21.1).

on.description: True to set the reaction, false to clear it.

FeedReactedPayload.title: FeedReactedPayload

FeedRetractedPayload.description: A post was retracted. The projection keeps a tombstone row and drops the body.
FeedRetractedPayload.title: FeedRetractedPayload

FeedTag.description: One `#tag` or `@mention` found in a post body, as carried in the event payloads.

end.description: Character offset just past the last character of the tag.

kind.description: Kind of the tag after resolution.

namespace.description: For code and mention tags written `ns:value`, the part before the colon.

record_id.description: For a record tag that resolved to a record, that record's id.

start.description: Character offset of the sigil in the body.

text.description: The tag as written, without its leading sigil (`47-1234-S03`, `area:A12`, `party:acme-nde`).

FeedTag.title: FeedTag

File.description: One file attached to a record, in its current lifecycle state.

deduplicated.description: True when the object already existed in the store at upload time.

file_id.description: Immutable file identifier; equals the ledger `stream_id` of the file.

filename.description: Original file name, kept for display and download.

last_seq.description: Ledger `seq` of the last event applied.

record_id.description: The record the file is attached to.

report.description: Scan or processing report of the last `File.Processed` or `File.Rejected`.

revision.description: Position of the file among the attachments of its record and slot, starting at 1.

scope.description: Scope of the file, which is the scope of its record.

sha256.description: Lower-case SHA-256 hex digest of the bytes; the object key derives from it.

size.description: Size in bytes, verified by the server.

slot.description: Name of the record type's file slot; null for a generic attachment.

superseded_by.description: The file that replaced this one in a cardinality-one slot; null while it is current.

updated_at.description: Time of the last applied event (system time).

uploaded_by.description: Actor of the `File.Uploaded` event; the only reader while the file is quarantined.

version.description: Ledger `stream_version` of the last event applied.

File.title: File

FileProcessedPayload.description: A file passed its scan and is available.

supersedes.description: Ids of the files this one replaced in a single-file slot.

FileProcessedPayload.title: FileProcessedPayload

FileRejectedPayload.description: A file failed its scan and was rejected.
FileRejectedPayload.title: FileRejectedPayload

FileSlotCardinality.description: How many current files a slot holds (brief 20.1).
FileSlotCardinality.title: FileSlotCardinality

FileStatus.description: Where a file is in its quarantine lifecycle (brief 20.2).
FileStatus.title: FileStatus

FileUploadedPayload.description: A file was uploaded and attached to a record; it is quarantined until its scan finishes.

deduplicated.description: True when the bytes already existed.

record_id.description: The record the file is attached to.

slot.description: File slot; null for a generic attachment.

FileUploadedPayload.title: FileUploadedPayload

Hashtag.description: One tag of a post (hashtag, namespaced code, signal tag, topic or mention), or one subject record of a card (kind `record`). Cards have rows only for records, so the feed of a record includes its cards.

end_pos.description: Offset just past the tag; 0 for a card's subject row.

item_id.description: The post or card the tag belongs to.

namespace.description: For code and mention tags, the part before the colon.

record_id.description: For a resolved record tag, or a card's subject, the record.

seq.description: `seq` of the event that added the row; orders a card's subjects.

start_pos.description: Offset of the sigil in the post body; 0 for a card's subject row.

tag_key.description: Normalised text used to find the tag's feed (lower case). For a card's subject row, the record id.

tag_text.description: The tag as written, without its sigil. For a card's subject row, the record id.

Hashtag.title: Hashtag

Importance.description: Noise-control level (brief 21.3). System cards are low, posts normal, signal tags high.
Importance.title: Importance

InboundAppliedPayload.description: A delivery was mapped and its commands ran (or, for a dry-run endpoint, were planned).
InboundAppliedPayload.title: InboundAppliedPayload

InboundAuth.description: How an inbound request proves who sent it.
InboundAuth.title: InboundAuth

InboundCounter.description: Per-endpoint counters of accepted deliveries and of refusals by fixed code (never a header, a claim or a body).
InboundCounter.title: InboundCounter

InboundDelivery.description: One accepted inbound POST and what became of it. The raw body is an object, never a column.

command_count.description: How many commands ran (or were planned, for a dry run).

corrected_object_key.description: The corrected payload an admin supplied on a retry, as a new object.

endpoint_version.description: The endpoint version the delivery is mapped by.

error_message.description: A bounded message for a person; never a payload excerpt.

finished_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC of the last attempt.

InboundDelivery.title: InboundDelivery

InboundDeliveryEventPayload.description: Payload of an `Inbound.*` event. The stream is the delivery (`core.InboundDelivery`); no payload holds the request body, a header or a secret.
InboundDeliveryEventPayload.title: InboundDeliveryEventPayload

InboundEndpoint.description: `POST /in/{app}/{name}` (brief 18.5, 19.3). `mapping` is restricted JSONata; `allowed_commands` is the subset of the automation commands the endpoint may produce; it runs as `service_actor` with `access`. The signing secrets are in `int_secret`; `current_secret_id` names the newest. Every earlier version stays in `cur_inbound_endpoint_version`, because a delivery is mapped by the version it was received under.

allowed_commands.description: A JSON list of command names.

version.description: Endpoint version (1, 2, ...). The ledger stream version is `stream_version`.

InboundEndpoint.title: InboundEndpoint

InboundEndpointCreatedPayload.description: An inbound endpoint was created. It starts disabled and in dry-run mode. Its secret is held outside the ledger.

external_schema.description: Which external schema the mapping reads.

secret_id.description: Id of the first secret (not the secret).

version.description: Endpoint version.

InboundEndpointCreatedPayload.title: InboundEndpointCreatedPayload

InboundEndpointDisabledPayload.description: An endpoint stopped accepting deliveries; it answers 404.
InboundEndpointDisabledPayload.title: InboundEndpointDisabledPayload

InboundEndpointEventPayload.description: Payload of an `InboundEndpoint.*` event. The stream is the endpoint (`core.InboundEndpoint`); a secret is held outside the ledger.
InboundEndpointEventPayload.title: InboundEndpointEventPayload

InboundEndpointRevisedPayload.description: An endpoint was revised; the event carries the whole new definition (no secret).

version.description: The new endpoint version.

InboundEndpointRevisedPayload.title: InboundEndpointRevisedPayload

InboundEndpointSecretRotatedPayload.description: A new secret was issued; the previous one keeps verifying until the overlap ends (at most 24 hours).

previous_expires_at.description: ISO-8601 time when the previous secret stops.

previous_secret_id.description: Id of the secret being replaced.

secret_id.description: Id of the new secret (not the secret).

InboundEndpointSecretRotatedPayload.title: InboundEndpointSecretRotatedPayload

InboundEndpointVersion.description: The definition of one endpoint version, as a JSON snapshot. A delivery records the version it was received under and is mapped by that version, whatever the endpoint says now.

version_id.description: The id of the event that made this version.

InboundEndpointVersion.title: InboundEndpointVersion

InboundFailedPayload.description: A delivery could not be applied; it is in the error queue until an admin retries it.

JobQueue.description: One queued, running or finished job. `job_id` is the id of the job record. A worker claims a row by moving it to `running` with a lease; a lease that expired makes the row claimable again (the work is retried, or failed when `attempt` has reached `max_attempts`). Completion is accepted for the claimed `attempt` only, so a late worker whose lease was taken over cannot finish a job twice.

attempt.description: Number of times the job has been claimed; the claim that is running now is this attempt.

finished_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC when the job reached done, failed or cancelled.

job_id.description: The id of the job record (a ledger stream id).

kind.description: The job kind a handler is registered for, for example `extract`.

last_error.description: The latest failure, cut to 500 characters; never a stack trace.

lease_owner.description: The worker that holds the claim; null when not running.

lease_until.description: ISO-8601 UTC; the claim of a running job expires here.

max_attempts.description: A job is failed for good when a claim would be attempt `max_attempts` + 1.

priority.description: Higher runs first among claimable jobs.

run_after.description: ISO-8601 UTC; the job is not claimable before this moment (a retry waits here).

scope.description: The scope of the job record.

started_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC of the latest claim.

state.description: queued, running, done, failed or cancelled.

JobQueue.title: JobQueue

ThreadParticipantRow.description: One person in a thread, with why: the record's creator, an author, someone mentioned or a dispatcher. Followers and assignees wait for their models.

actor.description: `user:<id>`, `agent:<id>` or a mention as typed (`crew:P-07`) when it names no account.

ThreadParticipantRow.title: ThreadParticipantRow

ThreadRow.description: One row per thread, with the counts. The id of the record it belongs to is the key.

last_seq.description: `seq` of the latest event of the thread.

version.description: Ledger `stream_version` of the thread stream after the last event applied.

ThreadRow.title: ThreadRow

TypeRegistrationDeprecatedPayload.description: The owner retired a version. Existing instances stay readable and editable; no new instance can be created.
TypeRegistrationDeprecatedPayload.title: TypeRegistrationDeprecatedPayload

TypeRegistrationQuarantinedPayload.description: A type package failed validation, or its files changed under a version that is already registered. The report lists every problem (`kind`, `path`, `detail`). A conflict never removes a registration that is already active.

content_hash.description: sha256 over the canonical `type.lock` form of the files as found.

type_ref.description: `<namespace>.<name>@<version>`, or `invalid:<relative path>` when the path is not a package path.

TypeRegistrationQuarantinedPayload.title: TypeRegistrationQuarantinedPayload

TypeRegistrationRegisteredPayload.description: A type package validated and was registered. The package files stay where they are; this event holds metadata only. `content_hash` is the sha256 of the canonical bytes of the package's `type.lock`.

content_hash.description: sha256 over the canonical bytes of `type.lock`.

location_uri.description: Where the package files are, for example `file:///srv/types/co.acme/LiftPlan/1.0.0`.

namespace.description: Namespace, dotted lower-case segments, for example `co.acme`.

schema_hash.description: Hash of the compiled class: the schema a stored body validated against.

version.description: Semantic version `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`.

TypeRegistrationRegisteredPayload.title: TypeRegistrationRegisteredPayload

TypeRegistrationRow.description: One registered type version: the current state of the stream `type:<namespace>.<Name>@<version>`. `type_name` (`co.acme.LiftPlan`) is what a record's `type` holds. An `active` or `deprecated` row whose files later changed keeps its status and shows the changed hash in `conflict_hash`, with the conflict in `report_json`.

conflict_hash.description: Content hash of changed files refused under this registered version.

first_seq.description: `seq` of the first event of the stream.

index_fields.description: JSON list of index field names.

last_seq.description: `seq` of the last event of the stream.

owner.description: Actor that registered it; null for a quarantined row.

pset.description: Name of the pset that holds the index fields of instances.

report.description: JSON list of `{kind, path, detail}`: why it was quarantined, or the conflict that was refused.

version_n.description: Stream version after the last event applied.

TypeRegistrationRow.title: TypeRegistrationRow

TypeStatus.description: Where a registered extension type version is in its life.
TypeStatus.title: TypeStatus

WebhookAttempt.description: The log of one delivery attempt (status, latency, response excerpt).

attempt.description: 1 for the first attempt of the delivery.

response_excerpt.description: First 512 characters of the response body, control characters removed.

status.description: HTTP status; null when no response was received.

WebhookAttempt.title: WebhookAttempt

WebhookCursor.description: How far the dispatcher has read the outbox.
WebhookCursor.title: WebhookCursor

WebhookDelivery.description: One event to be delivered to one subscription, with its retry state.

body.description: The exact JSON text that is sent (and re-sent on every retry), built once when the delivery was created.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC. The retry deadline counts from here.

dead_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC when the delivery was dead-lettered.

dedupe_key.description: `<seq>` for a live delivery, `<seq>:<origin>:<ulid>` for a replay or redrive.

delivered_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC of the successful attempt.

last_error.description: Short reason of the last failure (no secrets, no response bodies beyond an excerpt).

last_status.description: HTTP status of the last attempt; null for a network error or a blocked target.

lease_owner.description: Worker id that holds the lease.

lease_until.description: ISO-8601 UTC while a worker holds the delivery; an expired lease can be taken over.

next_attempt_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC. A pending delivery is not tried before this time.

replay_of.description: For a redrive, the dead delivery it re-enqueued.

seq.description: Ledger `seq` of the event; deliveries of one subject go out in this order.

WebhookDelivery.title: WebhookDelivery

WebhookEventPayload.description: Payload of a `WebhookSubscription.*` event. The stream is the subscription.
WebhookEventPayload.title: WebhookEventPayload

WebhookHealth.description: Failure bookkeeping per subscription, for auto-disable and the operator screens.

consecutive_dead.description: Deliveries dead-lettered since the last success.

failing_since.description: ISO-8601 UTC of the first failed attempt since the last success; null while healthy.

WebhookHealth.title: WebhookHealth

WebhookSecret.description: A signing secret of a subscription. Secrets never enter the ledger or the logs.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC. A rotated-out secret keeps signing until this time (the overlap), then retires.

secret.description: `whsec_` plus the base64 of 32 random bytes (the Standard Webhooks format).

WebhookSecret.title: WebhookSecret

WebhookSubscription.description: An outbound webhook (brief 18.4): where to send, what to send, and how. One row per subscription in its current state.

active_windows.description: JSON list of `{"from": seq, "until": seq or null}`. An event is delivered when `from < seq <= until` for some window (`until` null is open). Creation and every enable open a window; a disable closes the open one. Events committed while disabled are not delivered unless replayed.

current_secret_id.description: The newest signing secret (the value lives in `wh_secret`, never here).

event_schema_version.description: Event schema version pin. Only `v1` exists.

expires_at.description: After this time the subscription no longer receives events.

filter.description: A `SubscriptionFilter` as a JSON object; `{}` selects every event.

integration_app.description: The integration app the subscription belongs to, when there is one.

name.description: Short label for lists and logs.

owner.description: Actor who owns the subscription and is notified of auto-disable.

scope.description: The scope the subscription lives in. `company` sees every project; a project sees itself.

target_url.description: `https://` URL of the receiver. Checked against the egress policy at every attempt.

WebhookSubscription.title: WebhookSubscription

WebhookSubscriptionCreatedPayload.description: A webhook subscription was created. The signing secret is held outside the ledger.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 time after which the subscription stops.

secret_id.description: Id of the first signing secret (not the secret).

WebhookSubscriptionCreatedPayload.title: WebhookSubscriptionCreatedPayload

examples: {"detail": "5 deliveries dead-lettered since the last success", "reason": "sustained_failure"}

detail.description: Free-text detail, for example the failure counts.

WebhookSubscriptionDisabledPayload.title: WebhookSubscriptionDisabledPayload

WebhookSubscriptionEnabledPayload.description: A disabled subscription started receiving events again, from this event on.
WebhookSubscriptionEnabledPayload.title: WebhookSubscriptionEnabledPayload

WebhookSubscriptionSecretRotatedPayload.description: A new signing secret was issued; the previous one keeps signing until the overlap ends.

previous_expires_at.description: ISO-8601 time when the previous secret stops signing.

previous_secret_id.description: Id of the secret that is being replaced.

secret_id.description: Id of the new secret (not the secret).

WebhookSubscriptionSecretRotatedPayload.title: WebhookSubscriptionSecretRotatedPayload

WebhookSubscriptionUpdatedPayload.description: A subscription's name, target, filter or payload mode changed.

changes.description: Object of field name to [old, new].

WebhookSubscriptionUpdatedPayload.title: WebhookSubscriptionUpdatedPayload

WorkflowState.description: The state a record is in, since when, and by which transition it got there.

entered_at.description: When the record entered the state (`state_entered_at`).

record_id.description: The record (ledger stream) the state belongs to.

transition.description: Name of the transition that led here.

workflow.description: Identifier of the workflow definition, for example `core.review`.

workflow_version.description: Version of the workflow definition that was in force.

WorkflowState.title: WorkflowState

WorkflowTransitionedPayload.description: A record moved from one workflow state to another.

effective_schema_hash.description: Hash of the effective schema in force.

guards_evaluated.description: List of {kind, passed, message} for each guard that ran.

signature.description: Signature data when the transition was signed.

WorkflowTransitionedPayload.title: WorkflowTransitionedPayload
